jobs.title: Lead Software Engineer (.NET FullStack)
jobs.description:
**Overview**
------------

The **Senior Fullstack .NET Developer** is a highly hands\-on engineer passionate about building high\-quality, scalable software. This role focuses primarily on designing, developing, and delivering full\-stack applications — with technical leadership demonstrated through engineering excellence, code quality, and deep ownership rather than people management. You will spend the majority of your time writing code and solving complex engineering problems end to end.**Technology Tools**
--------------------

* **Front\-End:** React, Angular, HTML, CSS, JavaScript,
* **Back\-End:** .NET,
* **APIs:** RESTful APIs, GraphQL
* **Databases:** SQL, NoSQL
* **DevOps \& Delivery:** Docker, CI/CD Pipelines, Git
* **Cloud Platforms:** AWS, Azure, GCP

**Your Role Responsibilities — Here's What You'll Do**
------------------------------------------------------

* Design, develop, and deliver end\-to\-end full\-stack features with a strong focus on quality, performance, and scalability across front\-end and back\-end systems.
* Build and maintain RESTful and GraphQL APIs, services, and business logic to support reliable and scalable application architecture.
* Develop modern, responsive, and high\-performance user interfaces using front\-end frameworks such as React, Angular, or Vue.
* Perform thorough code reviews, contribute to improving code quality and long\-term maintainability, and debug production issues with durable, well\-considered fixes.
* Collaborate closely with product managers, designers, and engineers to deliver features while contributing to key architectural decisions and staying deeply involved in implementation.
* Reduce technical debt and improve existing systems through strategic refactoring and modernization, demonstrating technical leadership through code quality, system design, and end\-to\-end ownership.

**Role Essentials — What You Bring**
------------------------------------

* 6–10\+ years of professional software development experience with strong, hands\-on expertise in full\-stack development using **.NET** on the back end.
* Strong proficiency in front\-end technologies including React, Angular, or Vue, with solid command of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, or TypeScript.
* Proven experience building and consuming RESTful or GraphQL APIs, grounded in strong software design principles and patterns.
* Solid understanding of SQL and/or NoSQL databases, data modeling, and application performance optimization techniques.
* Experience with Git and collaborative development workflows, with a strong ownership mentality and the ability to work independently on complex engineering challenges.

**What We'd Like to See — Preferred Skills**
--------------------------------------------

* Experience building cloud\-based applications on AWS, Azure, or GCP, with familiarity with microservices architecture and distributed systems.
* Hands\-on experience with Docker and containerized deployments, including CI/CD pipelines and automated testing frameworks.
* Understanding of application security best practices, performance tuning, and logging/monitoring tools.
* Experience modernizing legacy systems and delivering within Agile/Scrum team environments.
* Exposure to AWS Cost Analysis / FinOps practices, or contributions to open\-source projects or technical communities.

jobs.title: Senior AI Engineer
jobs.description:
**Our Company**


At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.


**What You’ll Do**


As a **Senior AI Engineer**, you will play a key role in designing and delivering highly scalable, next generation AI products within our AI stack. You will work in a technically rich environment with talented peers, contributing to product planning, design, and execution while influencing the evolution of Teradata’s AI capabilities.


In this role, you will:


* Design, develop, and maintain high quality systems, services, and applications with an emphasis on scalability, reliability, and performance.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional engineers and product partners to shape design and consistently deliver end to end features.
* Build and integrate robust RESTful APIs, ensuring security, data consistency, and maintainability.
* Work with SQL and NoSQL databases to implement efficient data models and service access patterns.
* Apply and experiment with AI/ML technologies, including agentic AI and large language models (LLMs).
* Use AI powered engineering tools to improve development quality, speed, and productivity.
* Mentor engineers, supporting them in technical planning, implementation, and best practices.
* Identify and resolve system performance bottlenecks, optimizing code, design, and infrastructure.
* Write unit and integration tests and participate in code reviews to uphold engineering excellence.
* Investigate production issues, ensuring timely and effective solutions.
* Stay current with emerging trends in engineering, AI/ML, and cloud\-native technologies.

**Who You’ll Work With**


You will be part of a high\-performing engineering team building core components of Teradata’s AI platform. You will collaborate closely with other engineers, AI/ML specialists, product managers, cloud architects, and partner teams across the company. The role offers opportunities to contribute directly to Teradata’s AI product roadmap and technological direction.


**What Makes You a Qualified Candidate**


(Nonnegotiable qualifications)


* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent from a recognized institution.
* 5\+ years of experience in backend services, distributed systems, or data platform development.
* Strong proficiency in Java, Go, or Python for service development.
* Good understanding of design principles, distributed system patterns, and service framework.
* Hands\-on experience designing and developing RESTful APIs.
* Experience with SQL and NoSQL databases and data modelling.
* Strong debugging, problem solving, and troubleshooting skills.
* Experience with modern containerization and orchestration tools such as Kubernetes.
* Knowledge of public cloud platforms.
* Experience with AI productivity tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot).
* Ability to work independently, drive workstreams, and deliver high quality outcomes.
* Strong communication and collaboration skills.

**What You’ll Bring**


(Preferred qualifications)


* Familiarity with messaging systems such as Kafka.
* Experience experimenting with or implementing AI/ML technologies, Agentic AI, or LLMs.
* A track record of influencing design decisions and driving engineering best practices.
* The ability to mentor engineers and guide them through design, planning, and execution.
* A proactive mindset and comfort working in fast paced, dynamic environments.
* Curiosity, adaptability, and a passion for building impactful AI\-driven products.

\#LI\-PG1


Why We Think You’ll Love Teradata We prioritize a people\-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well\-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. We are committed to actively working to foster an inclusive environment that celebrates people for all of who they are.

jobs.title: Senior Manager System Reliability Engineering
jobs.description:
As the Senior Manager of System Reliability Engineering for the GridOS SaaS Products, you will serve as a strategic organizational change agent and the ultimate authority on production stability for our global grid software SaaS portfolio. You will bridge the gap between architectural design and real\-world operations, navigating organizational friction to drive a culture of high reliability and engineering excellence. You are the final "Gatekeeper" for production environments, owning the Change Management process and the authority to approve or halt deployments based on system health and responsible for meeting our SLA/SLO targets for critical infrastructure applications.
**Job Description**
===================


**Roles and Responsibilities**


**Primary Responsibilities**


**Day 0: Strategic Provisioning \& Design**


* **Standardize Cloud Infra Provisioning:** Lead initiatives to standardize and secure cloud infrastructure by extreme automation and accelerate customer onboarding to our SaaS platform
* **The "Golden Path":** Define and architect the standardized "Middle\-Mile" software delivery platform (IDP) using Backstage, ArgoCD, and GitHub Actions to eliminate bespoke "unicorn" deployment methodologies.
* **Follow\-the\-Sun Architecture:** Design and manage the global handover protocols and 24/7 operational coverage model across US, Europe, and Asia time zones to ensure seamless support without graveyard shifts.
* **Reliability Targets:** Establish enterprise\-wide Service Level Objectives (SLOs) and Service Level Indicators (SLIs) aligned with critical user journeys for global utility customers.

**Day 1: Release Governance \& Deployment**


* **Final Approval Authority:** Act as the ultimate authority for all production releases, enforcing rigorous change control and validating that all security and performance "quality gates" are met.
* **Progressive Delivery:** Oversee the implementation of advanced deployment strategies, including Canary and Blue/Green rollouts, ensuring automated rollback capabilities are verified.
* **SRE Center for Enablement (C4E):** Build and mature the C4E to provide coaching, standardized templates, and repeatable patterns that uplift reliability practices across all product teams.

**Day 2: Operational Excellence \& Optimization**


* **Incident Command:** Serve as the Lead Incident Commander for high\-severity (Sev1/Sev2\) events, leading the technical direction, communication, and containment efforts.
* **Blameless Culture:** Own the post\-incident lifecycle, facilitating blameless Root Cause Analysis (RCA) to ensure systemic fixes replace recurring operational risks.
* **Business Continuity:** Manage and validate end\-to\-end Backup and Disaster Recovery (DR) strategies, including cross\-region failover and automated recovery testing.

**FinOps \& Capacity:** Lead financial operations for the SaaS platform, optimizing cloud cost and performing long\-term capacity planning based on customer growth.


**Required Qualifications**


**Technical Qualifications**


* **Cloud Ecosystem:** Deep expertise in AWS core services (EC2, EKS, RDS, S3, IAM) and management tools (CloudTrail, CloudWatch).
* **Orchestration:** Advanced mastery of Kubernetes internals and EKS clusters across multi\-region architectures.
* **Continuous Delivery:** Expert knowledge of ArgoCD, GitHub Actions, and GitOps\-first workflows.
* **Automation:** Proficiency in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) using Terraform and configuration management via Ansible.
* **Observability:** Hands\-on experience with Prometheus, Grafana, observability platforms like Splunk or Datadog and OpenTelemetry standard to build comprehensive telemetry pipelines.

**Experience \& Leadership Qualifications**


* **Overall experience above 14 years.**

jobs.description:
**Keyloop bridges the gap between dealers, manufacturers, technology suppliers and car buyers.**
We empower car dealers and manufacturers to fully embrace digital transformation. How? By creating innovative technology that makes selling cars better for our customers, and buying and owning cars better for theirs.

We use cutting\-edge technology to link our clients’ systems, departments and sites. We provide an open technology platform that’s shaping the industry for the future. We use data to help clients become more efficient, increase profitability and give more customers an amazing experience. **Want to be part of it?** **Purpose of the Role**



The Product Owner owns the outcomes of a product area within Keyloop's core dealer management platform and its integration ecosystem: the systems that connect our platform to manufacturers, third parties, and other data sources. You'll work with an engineering team that combines deep platform expertise with delivery skill, turning integration and platform priorities into a backlog that keeps the ecosystem reliable and moving forward.



This role suits someone comfortable with technical complexity and long\-lived systems. You won't need to be an engineer, but you'll need to be able to hold your own in a conversation about APIs, data contracts, and system dependencies.



AI tooling is a growing and permanent part of how our Product and Engineering teams work, and this role is evolving with it. We expect Product Owners to grow into hands\-on AI\-building over time. This is a deliberate direction for the role, not a distant possibility, and we're looking for people who are genuinely ready and willing to make that journey, even if they're not there yet.

* Own and prioritise the development team backlog, balancing new integration delivery against platform stability and technical debt
* Write, refine, and prioritise epics and user stories, including ones with less obvious “customer” framing, where the customer is another system or internal team
* Work directly with engineers to understand technical constraints and translate them into backlog decisions
* Collaborate with the development team during Iteration Planning, stand\-ups, and reviews
* Accept completed work against the Definition of Done, including technical acceptance criteria
* Work with the Product Manager to align delivery priorities with the wider platform and integration roadmap
* Track delivery and reliability metrics, and use them to prioritise fixes and improvements
* Manage dependencies and sequencing across multiple integration partners or workstreams
### **Working with AI: where this role is going**


* Use AI tools (e.g. Claude) to support day\-to\-day product work now: drafting specs, exploring data, speeding up research and analysis
* Grow into hands\-on use of AI coding tools (e.g. Claude Code) to prototype and validate ideas yourself, with structured training and time provided to get there
* Apply judgement on where AI\-assisted output needs human review
* Understand that this capability will become a core, evaluated part of the role over time, not an optional extra

* Solid understanding of Agile principles and the Product Owner role within Scaled Agile
* Proven ability to write clear, concise epics and user stories, including technical/integration\-facing ones
* Comfortable engaging with technical detail: can read an API spec or data model well enough to write meaningful acceptance criteria, without needing to write the code
* Strong communication skills, able to bridge technical and non\-technical stakeholders
* Ability to analyse data (including system/reliability metrics) and make prioritisation calls
* Comfortable using AI tools day\-to\-day to support product work (e.g. research, writing, analysis), plus a clear, genuine willingness to grow into hands\-on AI\-building (e.g. Claude Code) as this becomes a core part of the role. This is where the Product Owner role at Keyloop is deliberately heading. Candidates should be ready to commit to that development path, even if not yet hands\-on today.


**Preferred**


* Experience owning backlog for a platform, integration, or infrastructure team (rather than a purely customer\-facing team)
* Familiarity with Jira, Confluence, or similar tools
* Relevant certifications (e.g. CSPO, SAFe POPM)
* Experience with legacy system modernisation or working across old and new tech stacks simultaneously
* Understanding of automotive aftersales processes (e.g. service booking, workshop operations, repair order lifecycle) and how they depend on integration and platform reliability
* Existing hands\-on experience using AI coding tools (e.g. Claude Code) to build or prototype software

Growing into hands\-on AI\-building is an expected part of every Product Owner's development here. This isn't an exception process, it's the plan for everyone. We'll invest in structured training and dedicated time to help you get there. What matters on day one is genuine readiness and willingness to make that journey, not that you've already arrived.



**Why join us?**
We’re on a journey to become market leaders in our space – and with that comes some incredible opportunities. Collaborate and learn from industry experts from all over the globe. At **Zithara.ai**, we are pioneering the next generation of **Customer Intelligence**. We are seeking a creative, data\-driven, and multi\-faceted **Social Media \& Omnichannel Marketing Executive** to join our growth marketing team in Hyderabad.


In this role, you won't just manage a single social page—you will own our brand’s digital footprint across organic social, paid advertising, and direct engagement channels like Email and WhatsApp. You will design, execute, and optimize cross\-channel campaigns aimed at capturing the attention of B2B retail business owners and C\-level executives in both India and Australia.

jobs.description:
**Description**
**Who is USP?**
 The U.S. Pharmacopeial Convention (USP) is an independent scientific organization that collaborates with the world’s leading health and science experts to develop rigorous quality standards for medicines, dietary supplements, and food ingredients. At USP, we believe that scientific excellence is driven by a commitment to fairness, integrity, and global collaboration. This belief is embedded in our core value of Passion for Quality and is demonstrated through the contributions of more than 1,300 professionals across twenty global locations, working to strengthen the supply of safe, high\-quality medicines worldwide.
   

  

 At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.
   

  

 USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit\-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment.
   

  

**Brief Job Overview**
 As part of the USP Programs, Regions, Operations, and Strategy (PROpS) Division, the Reference Standards Product Manager leads the development and management of the Small Molecules, Complex Generics, and General Chapters portfolio of reference standards. The Product Management function is responsible for overseeing the full product lifecycle (development to discontinuation), understanding key industry trends, applying data\-driven and analytic decision making and making customer\-focused recommendations that drive product portfolio growth. This role is an individual contributor who will be responsible for implementation of projects and processes that enable decisions about new and existing products. Core activities will also include the development of prioritization, forecasting, and financial models that enhance product mix, optimization and overall performance. This is a highly collaborative role that will be expected to work globally across the organization including Science, Operations, Sales, Regions, Pricing, Trade Compliance, and Marketing. As a product manager, this role will drive product strategy, lead cross\-functional teams in planning product roadmaps, discount and promotion strategies and ensure the successful launch and growth of innovative, high\-quality standards and solutions to drive USP’s mission and vision of improving global health.
   

  

**How will YOU create impact here at USP?**
 As part of our mission to advance scientific rigor and public health standards, you will play a vital role in increasing global access to high\-quality medicines through public standards and related programs. USP prioritizes scientific integrity, regulatory excellence, and evidence\-based decision\-making to ensure health systems worldwide can rely on strong, tested, and globally relevant quality standards.
   

  

 Additionally, USP’s People and Culture division, in partnership with the Equity Office, invests in leadership and workforce development to equip all employees with the skills to create high\-performing, inclusive teams. This includes training in equitable management practices and tools to promote engaged, collaborative, and results\-driven work environments.
   

  

**The Reference Standards Product Manager Has The Following Responsibilities**
* Item forecasting, pricing, and margin analysis
* Develop and present business case and supporting rationale for new and existing items
* Stays abreast of industry and market trends and key competitive intelligence to drive product strategies.
* Lead pipeline prioritization efforts, aligning pipeline to segment value and organizational strategies/prioritization
* Work with Industry Programs, Science and Operations, and others to facilitate new product launches
* Support Industry Programs, Regional and Sales staff in new product training and related customer solutions
* Support continuous improvement of forecasting and product performance against key success metrics
* Manage product mix and optimization for selection and discontinuation of products that enhance profitability
* Identify new product opportunities based on customer needs, feedback, and strategic insights
* Work collaboratively with Marketing, Sales, and Regions to launch and monitor feedback and uptake of items
* Maintain and update product roadmaps to meet targeted product pipeline and growth goals.


**Who is USP Looking For?**
 The Successful Candidate Will Have a Demonstrated Understanding Of Our Mission, Commitment To Excellence Through Inclusive And Equitable Behaviors And Practices, Ability To Quickly Build Credibility With Stakeholders, Along With The Following Competencies And Experience
   

  

* Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in business, Marketing or Science fields with a MBA Degree.
* Minimum five (5\) to seven (7\) years of professional experience in Pharmaceutical industry or related field

**Description**
**Who is USP?**
 The U.S. Pharmacopeial Convention (USP) is an independent scientific organization that collaborates with the world’s leading health and science experts to develop rigorous quality standards for medicines, dietary supplements, and food ingredients. At USP, we believe that scientific excellence is driven by a commitment to fairness, integrity, and global collaboration. This belief is embedded in our core value of Passion for Quality and is demonstrated through the contributions of more than 1,300 professionals across twenty global locations, working to strengthen the supply of safe, high\-quality medicines worldwide.
   

  

 At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.
   

  

 USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit\-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment.
   

  

**Brief Job Overview**
 As part of the USP Programs, Regions, Operations, and Strategy (PROpS) Division, the Materials Product Manager leads the development and management of a portfolio of Pharmaceutical Analytical Impurities, Analytical Reference Materials, and Certified Reference Materials. This role is focused on execution of USP goals to deliver quality products across the Materials portfolio. The Product Management function is responsible for overseeing the full product lifecycle (development to discontinuation), understanding key industry trends, applying data\-driven and analytic decision making and making customer\-focused recommendations that drive product portfolio growth.  As part of our mission to advance scientific rigor and public health standards, you will play a vital role in increasing global access to high\-quality medicines through public standards and related programs. USP prioritizes scientific integrity, regulatory excellence, and evidence\-based decision\-making to ensure health systems worldwide can rely on strong, tested, and globally relevant quality standards.

jobs.title: Principal Product Manager - APAC Onboarding & KYC
jobs.description:
**Company Description**
 Wise is a global technology company, building the best way to move and manage the world’s money.
   

  

**Min fees. Max ease. Full speed.**
 Whether people and businesses are sending money to another country, spending abroad, or making and receiving international payments, Wise is on a mission to make their lives easier and save them money.
   

  

 As part of our team, you will be helping us create an entirely new network for the world's money.
   

  

**For everyone, everywhere.**
**Job Description**
 More about
 **our mission** 
 and
 **what we offer** 
 .
   

  

 Wise is building the best way to move and manage money across borders. To make that possible, customers need to be able to join Wise quickly, safely, and confidently.
   

  

 We’re looking for a Principal Product Manager to join our Onboarding \& KYC team in Hyderabad. You’ll own high\-impact product work across APAC, helping Wise build onboarding and verification experiences that are low\-friction for customers and prevent financial crime.
   

  

 This is a senior role for someone who can operate in ambiguity, get deep into customer, regulatory, data, and technical details, and turn complex problems into shipped product outcomes.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**
* Own product strategy and roadmap for APAC onboarding, KYC and financial crime mitigation initiatives, from discovery through delivery, launch, measurement, and iteration.
* Build and scale digital identity verification and eKYC experiences across markets such as Japan, Singapore, Australia, New Zealand, Thailand, Malaysia, Hong Kong, and the Philippines.
* Partner with Engineering, Design, Analytics, Operations, Risk \& Compliance to balance conversion, customer experience, operational cost, regulatory requirements and financial crime risk.
* Lead complex localisation work, including integrating local identity providers, registry checks, and APAC\-specific controls into Wise’s global platform.
* Improve customer onboarding outcomes such as first product adoption, verification completion, time\-to\-verify, manual review rates, cost\-to\-serve, and quality of fincrime decisions.
* Mitigating risk of financial crime by ensuring our in\-product control environment accounts for country\-specific financial crime risks.
* Use data, customer insight, operational feedback, and regulatory context to prioritise what matters most.
* Help generalise APAC’s strongest onboarding and KYC capabilities so they can be reused by other Wise product teams.
* Staying close to the details: customer journeys, dashboards, service architecture, regulatory interpretations, edge cases, incidents, and operational workflows.


**Qualifications**
**What we’re looking for**
* Significant product management experience, ideally in finance/fintech, identity, onboarding, KYC, risk, compliance, fraud, trust \& safety, or another regulated domain.
+ 8\+ years in the workforce with ideally 5\+ years in product management or product\-management adjacent roles.
+ For those with material experience outside of product management we still require a minimum of 3\+ years in a senior product manager role

* A strong track record shipping customer\-facing products end\-to\-end, not just writing strategy.
* Excellent structured problem solving: you can break down ambiguous, multi\-stakeholder problems and create a practical path to impact.
* Strong analytical skills: you can define good metrics, interrogate data, work with SQL (or similar), and make trade\-offs based on evidence.
* Enough technical depth to work with engineers on systems, integrations, reliability, observability, and platform design.
* Strong customer focus, including a habit of using customer research, support insights, funnel data, and operational feedback to shape product decisions.
* Clear, concise communication and the ability to influence senior stakeholders without relying on authority.
* High ownership, strong attention to detail, and willingness to roll up your sleeves,


**Nice to have**
* Experience with KYC/KYB: digital identity, national ID systems, government registry integrations, biometric or document verification, business onboarding,
* Experience in financial crime prevention: risk models (e.g. machine learning models), fraud/scam product prevention
* Experience launching products across multiple countries or adapting global platforms to local market requirements.
* Experience working with distributed teams across product, engineering, compliance, operations, and regional leadership.


**Location**
 This role is based in Hyderabad, working closely with teams across Singapore, other APAC markets and Wise’s global product and engineering hubs.
   

  

 Additional Information
   

  

 For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.
   

  

 We're proud to have a truly international team, and we celebrate our differences.
   

  

 Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.
   

  

 If you want to find out more about what it's like to work at Wise visit Wise.Jobs.
   

  

 Keep up to date with life at Wise by following us on LinkedIn and Instagram.

Role: Change Management Process Manager


Location: Hyderabad, India


Expected Hours: PST hours (AM into Early Afternoon)


Team: I\&O Technology Support Services \- ITSM Team


Reports To: ITSM/CFS Process Manager \& Service Manager


Role Overview


The Change Management Process Manager is a leadership role responsible for the governance, execution, and continuous improvement of the Change Management process supporting global, 24/7 IT operations. The role is primarily focused on ensuring that changes are appropriately planned, risk\-assessed, approved, scheduled, communicated, implemented, and reviewed with minimal disruption to business services. Serving as the Change Management process owner, this position establishes standards and ensures consistent execution across Infrastructure, Operations, Security, Application, and Platform teams in alignment with ITIL best practices, organizational requirements, and business objectives. The role chairs and governs CAB, PreCAB, and ECAB meetings; reviews change activity for quality, compliance, and approval; manages exceptions and escalations; and partners with Incident, Major Incident, Problem, Release, and ServiceNow platform teams to strengthen cross\-process integration. Approximately 20 percent of the role provides backup support and process awareness for Release Management, including release calendar coordination, readiness reviews, lifecycle reporting, and coverage during absences or peak delivery periods.


Key Responsibilities

* Own, improve, and govern the Change Management process end to end, ensuring consistency, compliance, and operational discipline across global technology teams.
* Define, maintain, and enforce change policies, risk models, change types, approval frameworks, lead\-time requirements, blackout periods, and emergency change standards.
* Lead and facilitate CAB, PreCAB, and ECAB meetings, ensuring effective risk assessment, stakeholder participation, decision\-making, and documented outcomes.
* Review changes for completeness, business impact, technical risk, implementation planning, validation, rollback readiness, scheduling conflicts, and appropriate approvals.
* Monitor and manage the forward schedule of change to reduce collisions, competing activities, resource constraints, and business disruption.
* Ensure standard, normal, and emergency changes are properly documented, authorized, communicated, implemented, validated, and closed.
* Monitor change success rates, failed changes, unauthorized changes, emergency change usage, policy exceptions, and change\-related incidents.
* Lead post\-implementation reviews for failed, high\-risk, emergency, or business\-impacting changes and track corrective actions to closure.
* Define, track, analyze, and report Change Management KPIs, trends, compliance measures, and improvement opportunities to operational and leadership stakeholders.
* Partner with Incident, Major Incident, Problem, Event, Configuration, and Release Management teams to ensure strong cross\-process controls and data alignment.
* Work with the ServiceNow platform team to enhance Change Management workflows, risk calculations, approvals, automation, dashboards, notifications, and reporting.
* Lead recurring Change Management training and awareness sessions and maintain current process documentation, standards, procedures, and job aids.
* Fulfill audit reviews and artifact requirements on a monthly, quarterly, and annual basis, including evidence of approvals, controls, exceptions, and remediation activity.
* Provide backup Release Management support, including release calendar awareness, readiness review participation, release reporting, and coverage for critical release activities when needed.


Required Knowledge \& Skills

* Expert\-level knowledge of Change Management within ITIL\-based IT Service Management frameworks, with working knowledge of Release Management.
* Strong understanding of risk assessment, impact analysis, change categorization, scheduling, dependency management, approvals, emergency change controls, and governance.
* Experience working in audit\-focused environments and producing control evidence, compliance artifacts, KPIs, and remediation documentation.
* Hands\-on experience with the ServiceNow Change module, including workflows, approvals, risk models, reporting, dashboards, and integrations.
* Strong facilitation, organization, and stakeholder\-management skills, including the ability to lead CAB\-focused communications and challenge inadequate change plans.
* Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal, suitable for technical teams, business stakeholders, auditors, and leadership.
* Demonstrated ability to enforce governance while enabling delivery, operational agility, and appropriate risk\-based decision\-making.
* Experience working closely with engineering, infrastructure, security, application, platform, and service management teams.
* Working knowledge of release planning, release calendars, deployment readiness, JIRA environments, and Agile and Waterfall delivery methodologies.


Qualifications

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

The ideal candidate brings deep understanding of the software audit landscape, risk exposure analysis, and vendor compliance enforcement. This position will partner closely with procurement, legal, IT, and finance teams to maintain audit controls and support enterprise compliance with license agreements. **Key Responsibilities:**

**Audit Response \& Management:**

* Serve as the **primary point of contact** for software and vendor license audits initiated by third\-party vendors or auditors.

* Interpret requests from auditors and ensure timely, complete, and accurate responses while protecting the organization’s interests.
* Manage audit timelines and ensure audit activities are conducted efficiently and within legal and contractual boundaries.

**Audit Landscape \& Risk Profiling:**

* Maintain a current **audit landscape profile** of high\-risk vendors (e.g., Microsoft, Oracle, IBM, Adobe) and their audit practices.

* Identify vendors with potential audit exposure and proactively engage stakeholders to mitigate risk.

* Provide licensing expertise and interpretations of complex licensing models (SaaS, perpetual, subscription, consumption\-based).

**Documentation \& Controls:**

* Maintain **audit documentation libraries** including vendor correspondence, contract terms, deployment evidence, and audit reports.
* Develop and improve audit response templates, checklists, and workflows to ensure consistent and defensible audit responses.
* Support the creation and maintenance of standard operating procedures (SOPs) for audit handling and software license control.

**Stakeholder Engagement \& Reporting:**

* Partner with internal stakeholders to explain audit findings, recommend corrective actions, and support remediation.
* Deliver periodic reports and dashboards on audit status, exposure, and trends to executive leadership and compliance committees.
* Provide advisory support during contract renewals or renegotiations to address past audit issues and future compliance planning.

**Audit Preparedness \& Education:**

* Lead **internal mock audits** or dry runs to evaluate readiness for upcoming vendor audits.
* Conduct awareness sessions and training for IT and procurement stakeholders on license audit risks and mitigation strategies.
* Recommend tools, practices, and governance frameworks to support ongoing license compliance.

* Strong project management, coordination, and documentation skills.

* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel (pivot tables, data analysis) and collaboration tools (e.g., SharePoint, Teams, PowerPoint).
* Familiarity with ERP systems (SAP, Oracle) and ticketing systems (e.g., ServiceNow) a plus.

**Negotiation Awareness**: Understanding how audit outcomes impact vendor relationships and contract negotiations.

**Description**
**Who is USP?**
 The U.S. Pharmacopeial Convention (USP) is an independent scientific organization that collaborates with the world’s leading health and science experts to develop rigorous quality standards for medicines, dietary supplements, and food ingredients. At USP, we believe that scientific excellence is driven by a commitment to fairness, integrity, and global collaboration. This belief is embedded in our core value of Passion for Quality and is demonstrated through the contributions of more than 1,300 professionals across twenty global locations, working to strengthen the supply of safe, high\-quality medicines worldwide.
   

  

 At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.
   

  

 USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit\-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment.
   

  

**Brief Job Overview**
 We are seeking a detail\-oriented and strategic intellectual to join our Product Management team as a Product Management Analyst/Specialist. This is a non\-supervisory position to provide support for USP’s new initiative Materials Program. The individual will be responsible for product pipeline through identification and evaluation of relevant potential materials to introduce into the catalogue, managing the product pre\-pipeline, gathering and prioritizing product and customer requirements, and working with internal teams to assess new material categories. Our ideal candidate should have a background in science and product management experience and be able to manage data analysis while collaborating with cross\-functional teams.
   

  

**How will YOU create impact here at USP?**
 As part of our mission to advance scientific rigor and public health standards, you will play a vital role in increasing global access to high\-quality medicines through public standards and related programs. USP prioritizes scientific integrity, regulatory excellence, and evidence\-based decision\-making to ensure health systems worldwide can rely on strong, tested, and globally relevant quality standards.
   

  

 Additionally, USP’s People and Culture division, in partnership with the Equity Office, invests in leadership and workforce development to equip all employees with the skills to create high\-performing, inclusive teams. This includes training in equitable management practices and tools to promote engaged, collaborative, and results\-driven work environments.

* \[70%] Identification \& Evaluation

* Finalize technical attributes (CAS\#, Molecular Formula, Molecular Weight, IUPAC names etc) and Product attributes (rationale behind the potential targets) for new products.


 Additional objectives are to develop broad expertise in other areas to support new product introductions that will include API reference materials\& associated impurities, excipients, extractables and leachable, and more for potential inclusion into the materials portfolio.
   

  

* \[20 %] Market Assessment
* Understand industry/market trends and challenges, different customer segments, competitive analysis, and channel strategies as input to product launch roadmaps
* Evaluate product white space and portfolio gaps to identify additional product opportunities
* Assess product testing, needs pharmaceutical market especially generic drug market to identify new product development opportunities.
* Analyze trends in pharmaceutical standards catalog market including new product offerings, prices and discounts.
* Quantify market opportunities, primary and secondary research, generate data and establish product unit forecast
* \[10 %] Product Life Cycle Management
* Monitor product usage trends, sales performance, and customer feedback and demand to inform lifecycle decisions (product addition/deletion/promotion)
* Prepare periodic reports and dashboards on product performance.
* Identify/Evaluate product launch benchmarks including customer, market and financial performance indicators


**Who is USP Looking For?**
 The Successful Candidate Will Have a Demonstrated Understanding Of Our Mission, Commitment To Excellence Through Inclusive And Equitable Behaviors And Practices, Ability To Quickly Build Credibility With Stakeholders, Along With The Following Competencies And Experience
   

  

* Master’s degree in chemistry, Pharmacy, or a related field with a minimum of 4\-5 years of hands\-on experience as a process chemist with exposure to many API s \& diverse types of finished pharmaceutical products.

* Experience in developing projects/products in life science industry, CRO/CDMO or equival…

**Location:** Hyderabad, TG, IN, 500081

About Orica
  
  

At Orica, it’s the power of our people that leads change and shapes our futures. Every day, all around the world, our people help mobilise vital resources essential to progress. Established in 1874, we have grown to become the world leader in mining and civil blasting with a diverse of team of more than 13,000 across the world.
  
  

It’s an exciting time to join us – we are shaping the future of mining through digital and automated technologies, embracing new ways of thinking, pioneering innovation and reimagining the way we work.
  
  

About the role
  
  

We are looking for an Analyst \- Finance Business Partner to support our Mining Services business in India. This role combines financial analysis, business partnering, reporting, budgeting, forecasting, and commercial insights to help business leaders make informed decisions that drive performance and profitability.
  
  

Working closely with Finance Business Partners, Area Business Managers, Commercial Teams, Operational Leaders, and cross\-functional stakeholders, you will provide meaningful financial insights that support strategic and operational decision\-making.

and help drive performance, profitability, and growth across our Mining Services business

Financial Analysis \& Reporting

Investigate variances against budget and forecast.
  
Develop dashboards and performance reporting tools.
  
Support month\-end reporting activities.
  
  

Budgeting \& Forecasting
  
  

Assist with annual budgeting and forecasting processes.
  
Consolidate inputs from multiple stakeholders.
  
Monitor financial performance against plan.
  
Identify risks, opportunities, and business trends.
  
Support forecast submissions and management presentations.
  
  

Business Partnering

Help stakeholders understand key performance drivers.
  
Contribute to performance reviews and action planning discussions.
  
Build strong relationships across operations, commercial, and finance teams.
  
  

Commercial \& Operational Support
  
  

Analyse customer, contract, product, and service profitability.
  
Support pricing and margin improvement initiatives.
  
Monitor operational and financial KPIs.
  
Identify opportunities to improve business performance.

Build financial models and scenario analyses.

What you will bring
  
  

Bachelor's Degree in Finance, Accounting, Commerce, Economics, Business, or a related discipline.

Advanced Excel skills.

jobs.description:
**Hungry, Humble, Honest, with Heart.**

**The Opportunity**


This is a key engineering role in the Core Data Path (CDP) team, which maintains and evolves the Nutanix Distributed Storage Fabric (NDSF) \- the foundational storage layer that powers Nutanix hyperconverged and hybrid cloud infrastructure.


As a Senior Member of Technical Staff, you will work on Stargate, the data engine of NDSF. Stargate handles IO requests, data placement, dedupe, compression, encryption, resiliency, and healing from failures. The work sits close to the core of the product and directly impacts performance, reliability, scale, and customer experience.


We are looking for engineers who combine strong systems fundamentals with ownership, sound design judgment, and the ability to deliver high\-quality enterprise software in a complex distributed system.

**About the Team**


The CDP team was the first engineering team created at Nutanix and is responsible for the Nutanix Distributed Storage Fabric. We are hiring for the Stargate team, which is the data engine of the distributed file system.


The team works on some of the most interesting problems in storage: IO path design, data placement, resiliency, healing, performance, dedupe, compression, encryption, and scale. Even after many years of product maturity, the team continues to re\-invent core architecture to use newer technologies and improve product capabilities.


Our primary technology stack is C\+\+. We value deep ownership, clear design, simplicity, customer impact, and engineers who enjoy learning from one another.


We work as a global team across regions and collaborate asynchronously as much as possible. Engineers are given autonomy and responsibility while working closely with stakeholders across engineering, support, product, and customer\-facing teams.


We focus on building infrastructure that delivers strong ROI for customers, whether through performance, reliability, simplicity, or operational savings. The best engineers on the team combine curiosity, ownership, technical depth, and humility.

**Your Role**

* Design, implement, and deliver reliable, efficient, high\-performance software for large\-scale enterprise and hybrid cloud storage systems.
* Own medium\-to\-large feature areas end to end, from problem definition and design through implementation, validation, performance analysis, rollout, and production support.
* Develop a deep understanding of NDSF internals and use that context to build simple, robust solutions for customer and product requirements.
* Work on performance, scale\-out behavior, availability, resiliency, and failure handling in a distributed storage architecture.
* Debug complex production and test issues across distributed components, using data, logs, metrics, and strong systems reasoning.
* Collaborate closely with development, test, documentation, support, product management, and customer\-facing teams to deliver high\-quality outcomes.
* Mentor junior engineers through design reviews, code reviews, debugging guidance, and clear technical communication.

**What You Will Bring**

* Strong OS, systems programming, and distributed systems fundamentals, with the ability to apply them to practical design and implementation tradeoffs.
* Hands\-on experience building and maintaining enterprise\-quality software, preferably in C\+\+ or another low\-level systems language.
* Proven ability to own non\-trivial features or components in a production software system.
* Good debugging skills for concurrency, performance, memory, correctness, and failure scenarios.
* Ability to reason from first principles, break ambiguous problems into actionable pieces, and communicate design choices clearly.
* A customer\-first mindset and willingness to engage on production issues when engineering help is needed.
* Hungry, humble, honest attitude with heart, and a strong sense of collaboration in a dynamic engineering team.
* Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science or a related engineering field, or equivalent practical experience.
* Typically 9\-12 years of relevant systems software experience.


Good to have :

* Experience with distributed storage systems, filesystems, databases, consensus, replication, erasure coding, snapshots, caching, or data reduction technologies.
* Experience with performance analysis, profiling, benchmarking, scale testing, or production incident debugging.
* Familiarity with Linux internals, networking, concurrency primitives, memory management, or low\-level IO paths.
* Experience working with large C\+\+ codebases and writing maintainable, testable, production\-grade code.


Work Arrangement


Hybrid: This role operates in a hybrid capacity, blending the benefits of remote work with the advantages of in\-person collaboration. In locations where our workplace policy applies (i.e. San Jose, Durham, Mexico City, Bangalore, Pune, Hoofddorp, Belgrade, Barcelona, Singapore, Sydney and Tokyo), employees are expected to work onsite a minimum of 3 days per week to foster collaboration, team alignment, and access to in\-office resources. Workplace type may vary based on location and team requirements. Please speak with your recruiter for details. Additional team\-specific guidance and norms will be provided by your manager.

jobs.title: Sales Program Manager, ATES
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Are you passionate about building scalable sales channels that empower entrepreneurs and drive seller growth on the world's largest marketplace? The Amazon Trained Ecommerce Specialist (ATES) team is looking for a Sales Program Manager to help scale our third\-party partner ecosystem that recruits, trains, and supports new sellers on Amazon. ATES is part of the Amazon's scaled channel for seller acquisition and provides business opportunities to budding entrepreneurs while enabling Amazon to acquire new Selling Partners at scale and at the lowest cost. In this role, you will own and drive programs that incentivise third\-party partners to refer, launch, and grow sellers on Amazon Marketplace, directly impacting selection growth and GMS output.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

The Sales Program Manager will own the ATES partner channel end\-to\-end — from partner recruitment, onboarding, and certification through activation and performance management. This includes defining the strategy to grow the partner network, designing incentive structures and payout models that drive behaviors aligned to business goals (seller launches, FBA adoption, GMS targets), and building operational playbooks and program frameworks that enable the team to scale across geographies without adding headcount proportionally. The role requires analyzing program metrics (launches, partner activity, conversion rates, GMS output, cost\-per\-acquisition) to identify trends, diagnose root causes of misses, and write documents that propose solutions.  

  

The Sales Program Manager will partner with Marketing, Training \& Certification, Product, Operations, and Business Intelligence to remove blockers and improve the partner and seller experience. They will prepare and present business reviews (WBR, MBR, QBR) with data, narratives, and asks — and escalate risks before they become misses. They will manage partner communications, resolve escalations within defined SLAs, and identify automation and process improvement initiatives that reduce manual effort and lower cost\-to\-serve. The role demands setting goals, defining success criteria, and building mechanisms that surface gaps early and enable course correction.  

  

A day in the life  

You'll start your day reviewing ATES program dashboards — tracking partner activity, seller launches, conversion funnels, and GMS milestones. You might spend your morning analyzing why a cohort of partners has lower\-than\-expected conversion rates, diving deep into the data to identify root causes and drafting an action plan. Mid\-day, you could be leading a call with the training team to refine the certification curriculum based on partner feedback, or working with marketing on a campaign to recruit new ATES partners in an underserved geography. In the afternoon, you might review incentive payout data, collaborate with finance on program economics, and prepare a narrative document for your upcoming MBR. No two days are the same — you'll balance strategic thinking with hands\-on execution, always keeping the seller and partner experience at the center of your decisions.  

  

About the team  

The ATES team operates within Amazon's scaled channel for third\-party seller acquisition. Our mission is to scale seller acquisition through a network of trained third\-party partners — Amazon Trained Ecommerce Specialists and Seller Affiliates — who refer, launch, and grow Selling Partners on Amazon Marketplace. We believe in the power of entrepreneurship: our program provides individuals with the training, certification, and tools to build their own businesses while simultaneously expanding Amazon's seller ecosystem. The program started in India in 2016 and has successfully scaled to multiple geographies. We are a data\-driven, customer\-obsessed team that values ownership, bias for action, and delivering results at scale.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3\+ years of sales experience
* 4\+ years of B2B sales experience
* Experience analyzing data and best practices to assess performance drivers
* Experience closing sales and generating revenue

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience with sales CRM tools such as Salesforce or similar software
* Experience influencing C\-level executives

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

**JOB DESCRIPTION**  

  

  

We are seeking motivated individuals interested in analytics and problem solving to join the Digital Fraud Strategy team . The Digital Fraud Strategy team is responsible for leveraging advanced analytical tools to protect customers from fraud and scams in the digital payments space (Zelle, bill pay, wire transfers, ACH, funds transfers, and real time payments). We leverage machine learning fraud models, overlain with vendor and in\-house data as well as an array of analytical techniques to develop risk rules and strategies.


The primary objective of the team is to act as the end to end owner of fraud loss management of digital activity. The team focuses on three main areas: i.) Reducing fraud losses through identification of trends and development of strategies/business rules, ii.) reducing the cost of fraud alerts, by improving the efficiency of the alerts and/or automating review processes, and iii.) reducing negative customer experience and complaints by understanding points of friction and brainstorming solutions to resolve common pain points.


We are seeking individuals with intellectual curiosity and strong critical thinking and problem\-solving skills. The candidate should possess a natural curiosity to explore the unknown.


A successful candidate in this role will be strong analytically, while also able to convey trends, changes, and strategies to senior leadership both verbally and through text/PowerPoint. They should be an outside the box thinker with a desire/ability to work as a part of team towards a common goal.


The key skills for the job are:


* Ability to develop new creative solutions to challenges presented by fraud activity leveraging outside the box thinking.
* Manipulate and understand large amounts of complex data to monitor and uncover behaviors and trends in fraudulent activity.
* Experience with SAS and SQL or other analytical programming
* Strong communication skills with the ability to communicate complex data into a clear story to team members as well as senior leaders.
* A desire to work as part of a team, and ability to work with cross functional teams
* The ability to develop new fraud fighting products by designing requirements and working with technical business partners to implement these products using agile design methodology
* The ability to work on diverse tasks and respond to emerging issues
* Candidate should have a passion for problem solving

Qualifications


* At least 2 years of professional experience, experience in risk management, strategic analytics, or data science preferred
* Strong analytical, interpretive and problem solving skills with the ability to interpret large amounts of data and its impact in both operational and financial areas
* Ability to compress large amounts of data into short and concise presentations with sound business conclusions
* Ability to develop elegant and common\-sense solutions to complex business challenges
* Excellent analytical skills with the ability to comprehend and explain data / concepts in a clear and concise manner
* Strong knowledge of programming language like: Python, SAS, R and SQL
* Proficient in Excel \& PowerPoint
* Demonstrated experience with data analysis, designing \& analyzing experiments, and simplifying/communicating complex topics
* Strong P\&L knowledge and understanding of drivers of profitability

Morgan and Chase brands. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.

Our Consumer \& Community Banking division serves our Chase customers through a range of financial services, including personal banking, credit cards, mortgages, auto financing, investment advice, small business loans and payment processing. jobs.description:
A Snapshot of Your Day
   

  

 As a Product Owner \& Requirement Engineer, you will serve as the critical link between business stakeholders, end users, architects, and agile delivery teams. Your day will involve translating business needs into clear, actionable requirements, managing and prioritizing the product backlog, and ensuring that product deliveries generate measurable business value. You will drive collaboration across cross\-functional teams, helping shape product vision, define roadmaps, and ensure successful execution of strategic initiatives.
   

  

 How You'll Make an Impact
   

  

 Requirements Engineering
   

  

* Elicit, analyze, document, and validate business and functional requirements.
* Facilitate workshops, stakeholder interviews, and business process analysis sessions.
* Create and maintain Business Requirement Documents (BRDs), Functional Requirement Documents (FRDs), process flows, use cases, and user stories.
* Define and manage acceptance criteria while ensuring full requirements traceability.
* Assess and manage requirement changes, including impact analysis.
* Ensure alignment between business requirements, solution architecture, and technical design.


 Product Ownership
   

  

* Own, manage, and continuously refine the product backlog.
* Prioritize features, enhancements, defects, and user stories based on business value and strategic goals.
* Partner with stakeholders to define product vision, roadmap, and release priorities.
* Ensure backlog readiness for development teams through effective grooming and refinement activities.
* Support Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, sprint reviews, retrospectives, and Program Increment (PI) planning.
* Validate delivered functionality and formally accept completed user stories.
* Communicate product progress, priorities, and expectations to stakeholders.


 Stakeholder \& Delivery Management
   

  

* Act as the primary point of contact for requirements, product priorities, and stakeholder alignment.
* Collaborate closely with business users, software engineers, architects, UX designers, and project managers.
* Identify and resolve risks, dependencies, and delivery bottlenecks.
* Ensure delivered solutions meet business objectives and customer expectations.
* Drive continuous improvement through stakeholder feedback, product metrics, and data\-driven decision\-making.


 What You Bring
   

  

 Education
   

  

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, Business Information Systems, or a related discipline.


**Experience**
* 12\+ years of experience in software engineering, enterprise application delivery, and product development.
* 5\+ years of experience as a Product Owner, Requirements Engineer, Business Analyst, or a similar role within Agile environments.
* Proven track record in requirements management, backlog ownership, stakeholder engagement, and end\-to\-end product delivery.
* Strong experience working with cross\-functional teams, business stakeholders, architects, and software development teams.
* Experience operating within Agile, Scrum, SAFe, and Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) frameworks.
* Professional Product Owner certifications such as PSPO, CSPO, or equivalent certifications are preferred.


 Technical \& Functional Skills
   

  

* Requirements elicitation, analysis, and management.
* Business process modeling (BPMN, process mapping).
* User story creation, backlog refinement, and prioritization.
* Product roadmap planning and value\-driven delivery.
* Acceptance criteria definition and testing support.
* Agile/Scrum/SAFe methodologies.


 Tools \& Technologies
   

  

* Jira, Azure DevOps, or similar backlog management platforms.
* Confluence, Polarion, DOORS, or other requirements management tools.
* Strong understanding of SDLC practices.
* Knowledge of APIs, enterprise integrations, cloud platforms, and enterprise applications is an advantage.

* Excellent stakeholder management and relationship\-building skills.
* Strong communication, presentation, and facilitation capabilities.
* Analytical mindset with exceptional problem\-solving skills.
* Effective negotiation and prioritization abilities.
* Ability to influence and lead without direct authority.
* Strong customer focus and ownership mentality.


**About The Team**
 You will join a highly collaborative and agile product organization focused on delivering innovative digital solutions that enhance business performance and user experience. Working alongside architects, developers, UX specialists, and business leaders, you will play a key role in transforming strategic objectives into successful products and measurable business outcomes.
   

  

 Success Measures
   

  

 Success in this role will be measured through:
   

  

* Delivery of high\-quality and clearly documented requirements.
* Product backlog health, readiness, and prioritization effectiveness.
* Stakeholder satisfaction and engagement.
* Timely delivery of business value and product outcomes.
* Reduction in requirement\-related defects, rework, and delivery risks.
* Achievement of product goals, strategic objectives, and business KPIs.


 Who You Are
   

  

 You are a product\-minded professional who combines strong business analysis capabilities with a passion for product ownership. You thrive in agile environments, excel at translating complex business needs into clear solutions, and are motivated by delivering products that create meaningful value for customers and the business alike.

As a fast\-growing Series D company with deployments across five continents, it is building both industry\-leading merchandising solutions and foundational AI agents that are redefining how retail decisions are made. What makes Impact Analytics unique is its combination of deep retail domain expertise, strong innovation culture, and global presence. It is one of the few India\-born AI companies recognized globally by organizations like Fortune, Gartner, and the Inc. 5000\.For candidates looking to work on next\-generation AI products with global scale and real\-world impact, Impact Analytics is an exciting place to build your career. Here’s a link to our website: www.impactanalytics.co.
   

  

**The impact that you will be making**
 The platform is a store execution and allocation\-review app used by store associates and managers on the floor of high\-SKU physical retail locations, often with unreliable connectivity. The product decisions here are inseparable from mobile Android realities — screen real estate, offline behavior, interrupted workflows, and non\-technical users under time pressure. This role owns the requirements, workflow design, and day\-to\-day product judgment for the mobile experience, and must be able to reason about Android constraints directly rather than translating through someone else.
   

  

**What This Role Entails**
**Requirements \& Product Definition**
* Own detailed functional requirements for the mobile app: user stories with clear given\-when\-then acceptance criteria, workflow diagrams, and edge cases — not just feature summaries.
* Translate ambiguous business asks (from clients or internal stakeholders) into structured requirements, calling out open design decisions explicitly rather than letting them stay implicit.
* Define the end\-to\-end store associate and store manager workflows: review, edit, approval, and escalation paths, including what happens when a device is offline or a sync conflict occurs.
* Maintain a live backlog of open product decisions (e.g., edit\-window rules, approval bounds, disposition of un\-actioned items) and drive them to resolution with the right stakeholders.


**Mobile \& Android Judgment**
* Understand and account for native Android constraints in every requirement: offline\-first data availability, screen size and interaction patterns for a floor associate (often one\-handed, gloved, or interrupted), and battery/network limitations on retail\-grade devices.
* Partner directly with the mobile engineering team on feasibility and sequencing — able to ask the right technical questions about sync behavior, conflict resolution, and performance rather than treating mobile as a generic 'frontend.'
* Review mobile prototypes and builds hands\-on (not just via specs) to catch usability issues specific to Android and to field conditions before they reach UAT.
* Flag when a requirement has architectural consequences (e.g., forces a specific offline\-sync behavior) and route it to engineering early rather than after the design is set.


**Delivery \& Client\-Facing Work**
* Support active client delivery: participate in requirement walkthroughs, UAT planning, and client Q\&A on product scope and behavior.
* Work backward from delivery milestones (e.g., data sign\-off, go\-live) to sequence requirements and flag scope risk early, with a recommendation attached — not just a flag.
* Produce client\-ready documentation (FRDs, workflow diagrams, release notes) in plain business language, distinct from internal engineering specs.
* Coordinate with QA on test scenarios for mobile\-specific risk areas: offline usage, interrupted sync, low\-connectivity environments, and device variability.


**Platform Thinking**
* Continuously separate what is client\-specific from what should be configurable at the platform level, and flag anything that risks being hard\-coded to a single client's workflow.
* Contribute to the reusable configuration framework (personas, hierarchy depth, edit windows, approval rules) so future clients can be configured in rather than custom\-built.


**What Lands You This Role**
**Must Have**
* 8\+ years of product management experience, with at least 4\+ years specifically on a native Android or Android\-first mobile product (not a web product with a mobile\-responsive view).
* Demonstrated ability to write detailed, unambiguous requirements — given\-when\-then acceptance criteria, explicit edge cases, and open\-decision tracking — not high\-level feature descriptions.
* Working knowledge of core Android product constraints: offline data behavior, sync/conflict scenarios, notification and background\-task limitations, and device fragmentation — enough to have a real conversation with a mobile architect, not just a glossary\-level familiarity.
* Experience shipping a product used by non\-technical, operationally focused end users in a physical, time\-pressured environment (retail floor, warehouse, field service, logistics) — the design tolerance for error and training is very different from a desk\-based B2B tool.
* Comfortable working directly from a live backlog of open design decisions and driving them to closure with multiple stakeholders, rather than waiting for decisions to be handed down.


**Good to Have**
* Prior experience in retail, logistics, or supply\-chain software (store operations, inventory, warehouse management, delivery/route planning) — familiarity with allocation, replenishment, or capacity\-constraint concepts is a plus.
* Experience working on a multi\-client or multi\-tenant B2B SaaS product, with prior practice distinguishing client\-specific asks from platform\-level configuration.
* Experience producing client\-facing documentation and presenting product decisions directly to client stakeholders.

**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Amazon Wholesale India Private Limited (AWIPL) is Amazon's 1P B2B retail entity in India, serving enterprise and business customers across the large indirect\-spend market. We are looking for a data\-driven Business Analyst to be the analytical backbone of the AWIPL business and product team — turning raw data into the timely, accurate insights that leaders use to run the business every week.  

  

In this role you will own AWIPL's core reporting and analytics: the weekly business review (WBR) data and deck, automated flash reporting, and the deep\-dive analyses that inform selection, pricing, in\-stock, and GMS decisions. You will work closely with the Product, Business (VM), and Finance partners, and report into the AWIPL Product team. Success in this role means leaders trust the numbers, reports arrive on time, and manual reporting is progressively automated.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

Own and publish the weekly AWIPL Pre\-WBR deck — GMS (CPS \+ SSR) splits, WoW variance, goal\-to\-goal (G2G) tracking\- restructuring metrics as owners' needs evolve.  

Build and maintain automated flash reporting at ASIN and Brand level.  

Write, optimize, and maintain queries and pipelines on Data Central / DWP / Amazon internal data platforms (ETL profiles, InsightCrafter), and build self\-service dashboards for business teams.  

Ensure data quality and accuracy — validate outputs before publishing, reconcile against goals, and drive root\-cause fixes on data defects so business\-facing reports are consistently correct.  

Deliver ad\-hoc deep dives and data requests for partner teams and support monthly business reviews.  

Build scalable, automated tooling to reduce manual reporting effort and eliminate recurring data\-prep work.  

Communicate findings clearly to business and leadership audiences.  

  

A day in the life  

You start the week preparing the Pre\-WBR deck, validating the automated flash output that went out Sunday, and clearing any data\-quality flags raised by partners. Mid\-week you turn to a deep\-dive request from the VM or Finance team, optimize a slow query on Data Central, and extend a dashboard. Throughout, you partner with the Product team to make sure every number a leader sees is accurate and on time.  

  

About the team  

AWIPL is Amazon India's 1P B2B business. This role sits within the AWIPL Product organization and partners daily with Business (VM), Finance, and Tech to run the weekly business rhythm and inform decisions on selection, pricing, in\-stock, and growth.
